request.description: Server-driven journey: the first stage not yet done (`category`, `requirement`, `pre_check`, `consent`, `documents`, `verify_details`, `score`, `matching`, `apply`), the stages already done and what blocks the current one (e.g. unanswered question keys, missing consent purposes, missing document slots). Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.
